m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Now Wizard, stay calm... I have no quarrel with you. So, you have not forgotten me. I am touched. I will help you, Wizard.
The Tower, yonder - it contains a Portal that leads out of this dreadful place.
Why do I help you? If you cannot escape this place, you will die. And with you will die your memory of Belloq: me, in other words. So be quick!
You will need a Key to enter. Take one from these miserable little spiders, and the way will be open to you.
